data.title: Baccarat Hotel & Residences
data.about:
Embark on a journey into the world of luxury with Baccarat Hotel & Residences by H&H Development in Dubai. This exceptional creation pays homage to the rich heritage of the legendary crystal brand, weaving art and emotion into every aspect of Tower 1, the first of the two Baccarat towers.

The Baccarat Residences offer a lifestyle beyond compare, featuring 2, 3, and 4-bedroom apartments, as well as lavish 4 and 5-bedroom penthouse suites. Some of these suites provide mesmerizing vistas of the Burj Khalifa and the enchanting Downtown Dubai. The tower's zenith hosts exclusive penthouses that epitomize elegance and sophistication.

Situated in the heart of Downtown Dubai, residents will relish the convenience of accessing both the modern and historical facets of the city. Iconic skyscrapers and culturally vibrant attractions are within easy reach, ensuring a truly enriched living experience.

characteristics_module.title: Grand living at Baccarat Residences
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Iconic Brand Collaboration: A rare fusion of H&H Development and Baccarat’s 250-year luxury legacy.
  • Prestigious Location: Centrally located in Downtown Dubai, moments from Burj Khalifa and Dubai Opera.
  • Intimate Collection: Only 49 residences and 144 hotel rooms for an exclusive living experience.
  • Designer Interiors: Luxurious finishes with marble, crystal, and Baccarat’s signature burgundy accents.
  • Five-Star Service: Enjoy hotel-style hospitality with curated daily experiences and refined leisure.
  • Spacious Terraces: Each residence features a large outdoor terrace for elevated relaxation.
  • Spa-Like Bathrooms: Marble-adorned bathrooms with elegant fittings and designer details.
  • Crafted Luxury: Built with exceptional quality materials and meticulous attention to every detail.

location_tile.title: Perfectly situated in Downtown Dubai
location_tile.heading: location
location_tile.description:
Embrace the unparalleled Baccarat Residences Dubai location, nestled in the heart of Downtown Dubai, the prestigious hub of the city's cultural and vibrant scene. Here, you'll experience an instant and effortless connection to globally acclaimed institutions in the realms of fashion, art, and culture.

The strategic placement of the Baccarat tower along Sheikh Zayed Road, E11, between Al Wasl and Business Bay, ensures you are part of a bustling and active community. Revel in the closeness to numerous retail, shopping, and dining facilities in the vicinity, offering you the epitome of urban convenience.

Areas nearby:

  • Dubai Mall 0.9km
  • South Ridge Park 0.35km
  • First Path Montessori 1.3km
  • Mercato Beach 5.9km
  • Dubai International Airport 19.3km
